positions.name: MissingIdCrashGuardTest
positions.frame: what must the missing-id derive-id test reproduce and enforce to close the prod crash gap?
positions.why: src-1 fixes the reproduction target: the ## heading with no id field, the exact prod failure pattern the test is built to replicate. src-2 states the acceptance criteria that reproduction must be checked against: no crash, a valid slug produced. Read together they define one test's two halves — what it reproduces and what it must guarantee once reproduced. The conviction gradient (src-1 a flat claim about what the test does, src-2 a modal 'must' requirement) is itself part of the read: a witnessed fact paired with the standard it is held to, not two separate concerns.
